title: Rai Sahib Ram Jawaya Kapur v. State of Punjab

content.caseIdentity: Rai Sahib Ram Jawaya Kapur v. State of Punjab, AIR 1955 SC 549; (1955) 2 SCR 225
content.facts: The case concerned executive action and the constitutional distribution of governmental functions.
questionsBeforeCourt: What model of separation of powers does the Indian Constitution adopt?
Whether the Indian Constitution adopts a rigid separation of powers.
content.ratioDecidendi: India follows functional differentiation rather than the absolute rigidity associated with classical separation models.
content.holding: The Court articulated the Indian position.
content.relevance: Use as the Indian constitutional baseline for comparative study.
